---
title: "Dimensionality of the mental rotation task"
---

Tests the single-factor assumption behind the IRT models (supplementary Table
S15). Fits five models to the 53 overlapping item instances and the runs used
in the invariance comparison, with the same priors and fixed guessing parameter
as `02_fit_irt.qmd`: one factor; correlated 2D and 3D factors; a bifactor model
(general + 3D-specific); a testlet model (general + one factor per item class,
for dependence among repeated presentations of the same item); and a two-tier
model (correlated 2D and 3D factors + item-class factors). Also estimates the
2D-3D correlation separately by site, in a multigroup model with the paper's
scalar constraints.

Reads the overlap-item data from the 02 model record, so run 02 first. Takes a
few minutes, most of it the multigroup fit.

```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(mirt)
mirtCluster(4)
```

```{r}
rec <- read_rds(here("models/mrot/multigroup_dataset/overlap_items/mrot_2pl_f1_scalar.rds"))
dat <- as.data.frame(rec@data)
items <- colnames(dat)
is3d <- grepl("_3d_", items)
item_class <- sub("-[0-9]+$", "", items)
i2 <- which(!is3d)
i3 <- which(is3d)
idx <- \(i) paste(i, collapse = ",")
guess <- rep(0.5, length(items))
tech <- list(NCYCLES = 10000)

# the priors used in 02: slopes ~ N(1, 0.3), intercepts ~ N(0, 3)
add_priors <- function(vals) {
  slope <- grepl("^a", vals$name) & vals$est
  icpt <- vals$name == "d" & vals$est
  vals$prior.type[slope] <- "norm"; vals$prior_1[slope] <- 1; vals$prior_2[slope] <- 0.3
  vals$prior.type[icpt] <- "norm"; vals$prior_1[icpt] <- 0; vals$prior_2[icpt] <- 3
  vals
}
fit_mirt <- function(model) {
  v <- mirt(dat, model, itemtype = "2PL", guess = guess, pars = "values")
  mirt(dat, model, itemtype = "2PL", guess = guess, pars = add_priors(v),
       verbose = FALSE, technical = tech)
}
fit_bf <- function(specific, model2 = paste0("G = 1-", ncol(dat))) {
  v <- bfactor(dat, specific, model2 = model2, itemtype = "2PL", guess = guess, pars = "values")
  bfactor(dat, specific, model2 = model2, itemtype = "2PL", guess = guess,
          pars = add_priors(v), verbose = FALSE, technical = tech)
}
two_factor <- paste0("F2D = ", idx(i2), "\nF3D = ", idx(i3), "\nCOV = F2D*F3D")
class_id <- as.integer(factor(item_class))
```

```{r}
fits <- list(
  one_factor = fit_mirt(mirt.model(paste0("F = 1-", ncol(dat)))),
  two_factor = fit_mirt(mirt.model(two_factor)),
  bifactor   = fit_bf(if_else(is3d, 1L, NA_integer_)),
  testlet    = fit_bf(class_id),
  two_tier   = fit_bf(class_id, two_factor)
)
stopifnot(all(map_lgl(fits, \(m) extract.mirt(m, "converged"))))

slopes <- \(m) {
  it <- coef(m, simplify = TRUE)$items
  it[, grep("^a", colnames(it)), drop = FALSE]
}
comparison <- imap(fits, \(m, nm) tibble(
  model = nm, n_pars = extract.mirt(m, "nest"),
  logLik = extract.mirt(m, "logLik"), BIC = extract.mirt(m, "BIC"),
  AIC = extract.mirt(m, "AIC"), max_a = max(abs(slopes(m)))
)) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  mutate(dBIC = BIC - min(BIC), dAIC = AIC - min(AIC))

factor_r <- \(m) { v <- coef(m, simplify = TRUE)$cov; v[2, 1] / sqrt(v[1, 1] * v[2, 2]) }
```

```{r}
# Bifactor summaries from the general + 3D-specific model, on standardised
# (normal-ogive) loadings, ignoring the fixed guessing parameter.
std_loadings <- \(m) { a <- slopes(m) / 1.702; a / sqrt(1 + rowSums(a^2)) }
lam <- std_loadings(fits$bifactor)
uniq <- sum(1 - rowSums(lam^2))
common_g <- sum(lam[, 1])^2
common_s <- sum(lam[i3, 2])^2
bifactor_indices <- list(
  ecv = sum(lam[, 1]^2) / sum(lam^2),
  ecv_3d_items = sum(lam[i3, 1]^2) / sum(lam[i3, ]^2),
  omega_h = common_g / (common_g + common_s + uniq),
  omega_total = (common_g + common_s) / (common_g + common_s + uniq),
  loading_2d_general = mean(lam[i2, 1]),
  loading_3d_general = mean(lam[i3, 1]),
  loading_3d_specific = mean(lam[i3, 2])
)
bifactor_indices$omega_ratio <- bifactor_indices$omega_h / bifactor_indices$omega_total

# Share of each item class's common variance that is class-specific, from the
# testlet model.
lt <- std_loadings(fits$testlet)
class_specific <- tibble(item_class, type = if_else(is3d, "3D", "2D"),
                         g = lt[, 1]^2, s = rowSums(lt[, -1, drop = FALSE]^2)) |>
  summarise(share_specific = sum(s) / sum(g + s), .by = c(type, item_class))
```

```{r}
# 2D-3D correlation by site: multigroup two-factor model with the paper's scalar
# constraints and free latent means and variances.
mg_vals <- multipleGroup(dat, mirt.model(two_factor), group = rec@groups, itemtype = "2PL",
                         guess = guess, pars = "values",
                         invariance = c("slopes", "intercepts", "free_means", "free_var"))
mg <- multipleGroup(dat, mirt.model(two_factor), group = rec@groups, itemtype = "2PL",
                    guess = guess, pars = add_priors(mg_vals), verbose = FALSE, technical = tech,
                    invariance = c("slopes", "intercepts", "free_means", "free_var"))
stopifnot(extract.mirt(mg, "converged"))
site_r <- map(coef(mg, simplify = TRUE), \(g) g$cov[2, 1] / sqrt(g$cov[1, 1] * g$cov[2, 2])) |>
  unlist() |> enframe("dataset", "r")
```

```{r}
dimensionality <- list(
  comparison = comparison,
  r_two_factor = factor_r(fits$two_factor),
  r_two_tier = factor_r(fits$two_tier),
  site_r = site_r,
  bifactor = bifactor_indices,
  class_specific = class_specific
)
write_rds(dimensionality, here("models/mrot_dimensionality.rds"))
print(comparison)
str(dimensionality[-1])
```
